audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Level 1 to Aurora while both the content prose and the spike text say the opposite ('At level 1 you actually win the opener', 'Granite Shield plus your starting MR lets you walk up and W-auto for a free CS').
audit.why: Twofold Hex is a 9s single missile at level 1 and Granite Shield absorbs 10% of Malphite's max health; Aurora has no kill setup until she has The Weirding to disengage. The chart row contradicted its own explanation.
audit.corrected: Flagged for the user rather than edited: a side/win value is 6 characters and any replacement breaks the applier's +-10% length rule, so I could not propose the Level 1 flip as an edit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike reference pointed at an ability called 'Twofold Hunt', which Aurora does not have. One line even called it '(Blink)'.
audit.why: Her real Q is Twofold Hex — a poke missile, not a blink. Her escape is Across the Veil (W) at 22/21/20/19/18s, and her ultimate is Between Worlds at 140/120/100. The spike Malphite has to track is the 22s escape, because that is what decides whether Unstoppable Force connects.
audit.corrected: Replaced the fabricated name with Across the Veil throughout the full layer and rebuilt breakdown.cooldowns on the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twofold Hex was treated as a one-way poke. Its recast — the half that actually catches Malphite — was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text: the missile curses what it hits, and she can recast to draw active curses back toward herself, damaging anyone in the return path. A Malphite who sidesteps the outgoing missile and then walks his usual line back to the wave eats the return. The instruction is to leave the return line, not just the first pass.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dontsFull[2].d to state the recast and the return line.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'Build armor vs her AP' Don't had a body copy-pasted from the generic trade line, and nothing anywhere flagged her sustain.
audit.why: Spirit Abjuration heals her off the spirits her spells and attacks pull out of everything she damages, so a Malphite who plans to grind her down in a poke war is grinding against a heal. Magic resist plus Grievous Wounds is the pair, not armour.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dontsFull[0].d to name the damage type and the heal together.

notes: 'Twofold Hunt' is a fabricated ability name and was used throughout the full layer, once labelled '(Blink)'; her Q is Twofold Hex and her blink is Across the Veil (W). I changed only the Level 1 side, where the content prose is explicit that Malphite wins the opener; the rest of the chart still gives Aurora nearly every row while the headline win rate is 53.59% for Malphite and diff reads FAV — that pair still looks wrong to me but I had no evidence to re-rate individual rows, so I left them. The kit file's 'enemy-dash-deniable' entry claims Malphite's Q and E shut off Across the Veil and Between Worlds; Riot's descriptions give Malphite only a slow and an attack-speed slow, so I treated that as a flag misfire and did not write it. I could not propose the Level 1 side flip as an edit: 'side' and 'win[N]' hold 6-character values ('Aurora'/'Malphite') and any change is outside the applier's +-10% length band, so it would be rejected. It needs to be set by hand or by mirror-fix.js.
